title: Appliance Rebates in Sacramento 2026: $750 for Induction from SMUD | HomePowerRebate
desc: SMUD pays $750 when an induction cooktop or range replaces gas ($100 from electric), plus $100 off a clothes washer and $50 off a refrigerator at partner stores.
badge: Up to $750 for gas to induction
lead: SMUD pays $750 when you replace a gas cooktop or range with induction, and $100 when you replace an electric one. Washers and refrigerators get smaller instant discounts, but only at two named retailers.
cards_intro: These figures come from SMUD's rebates for my home page, which we read on October 2, 2026. SMUD's rebate center is reachable at rebate.center@smud.org or 916-732-7550.

after_cards:
Add the City of Sacramento's washer rebate

SMUD's page notes that the City of Sacramento's Department of Utilities offers a rebate of up to $125 for replacing an old washing machine with a new high-efficiency one. A washer can therefore earn $100 from SMUD at the register and up to $125 from the City, which are separate programs with separate rules.
sections: Gas to induction is the big one

An induction cooktop heats the pan directly with a magnetic field, so there is no flame and no combustion in the kitchen. SMUD pays $750 to swap gas for induction, the highest appliance rebate on its list, with photos of the old unit in place and the new unit installed. The cooktop or range must measure at least 24 inches. Standalone cooktops and ranges with an induction cooktop built in both qualify. Ask the electrician about the 240-volt circuit before you buy, because many gas kitchens do not have one.

The $100 washer and $50 refrigerator rebates are given at the register, and SMUD says they are valid only at The Home Depot and RC Willey locations in its service area, on select models. Ask a store associate which models qualify for the SMUD instant rebate. A washer bought elsewhere does not get it, so shop at one of the two stores if the rebate decides the purchase.

SMUD's $750 is much larger than Burbank's $200 induction rebate for standard customers (Burbank) and Glendale's $400 for an electric range (Glendale), though Burbank's low-income amount is far higher. SMUD's electrification package also pays up to $4,000 for a smart panel or new circuit when gas is being replaced, which can cover the wiring for an induction range.

If a heat pump or a water heater is also on your list, those rebates are far larger: SMUD pays up to $3,000 and $4,000. See Sacramento heat pump rebates and Sacramento water heater rebates. The same electrician who wires a heat pump can often add the induction circuit in the same visit, which saves a call-out fee.
claim_heading: How to claim a SMUD appliance rebate
claim_steps: Confirm that SMUD is your electric utility.
For induction, choose a cooktop or range of 24 inches or larger and take a before photo of the old gas unit in place.
Install the new unit, and take an after photo.
Apply online through SMUD's induction cooktop application.
For a washer or refrigerator, shop at The Home Depot or RC Willey in SMUD's territory and ask which models qualify.
Contact the rebate center at 916-732-7550 with questions.
